action_instruction: Reading the sprint title from the Sprint Board tab
intent: the sprint title shown in the Sprint Board tab

action_params.query: the sprint title shown in the Sprint Board tab

action_instruction: Reading the Teamz connection status message

action_params.condition: the message "Connected to Teamz as Demo User. No errors." is shown
action_params.expected_value: Connected to Teamz as Demo User. No errors.

output_value: Connected to Teamz as Demo User. No errors.

action_instruction: Checking the columns shown in the Sprint Board tab
intent: the tab has To do, In progress and Done columns

action_params.condition: the tab has To do, In progress and Done columns
action_params.query: the tab has To do, In progress and Done columns

assertion_tree.description: the tab shows "Sprint 38 · Sep 14 – Sep 25" with To do, In progress and Done columns, and the message "Connected to Teamz as Demo User. No errors."

sub_results.description: the tab has To do, In progress and Done columns
the message "Connected to Teamz as Demo User. No errors." is shown
sub_results.expected: Connected to Teamz as Demo User. No errors.

variable_refs.{{teamz_connection_message_check}}: Connected to Teamz as Demo User. No errors.

assertion_tree.verification: The current tab displays the specified sprint title, the To do, In progress, and Done columns, and the specified connection message.
